2026 Leaf Metal Golden Set Tennis

Tennis fans rejoice! Classic Ace designs return for 2026 Leaf Metal Tennis Golden Set, including the iconic 2006 release! These crisp, tasteful cards are now available in Leaf Metal technology, making them a must-have for any collector of the court’s greatest athletes. 2026 Leaf Metal Tennis Golden set pays tribute to the game with Famous Fans, Historic Cut Autographs, and Hall of Fame signatures. These cards embody the refined aesthetic of tennis, and each functions as a museum-quality piece for any collection. Quiet, Please! How often are those words echoed throughout the legendary locales of the highest- profile tournaments in the sport? Hardcore collectors will consider the trifecta of these inserts a must-have - the reproach of the official, in London, on perennial ryegrass! Tennis challenged the conventions of sport, and so too did the Dada movement for art. These playful inserts combine those two forces: super-scarce cards with eye-popping designs sure to strike envy in any collector who can’t find one!
